questions: When choosing K elements that include A_i, are we allowed to choose the same index multiple times (i.e., is selection with replacement allowed)?
Should the GCD be computed over exactly K chosen elements, or can it be over at most K elements?
Is the goal to find the maximum possible GCD among all valid choices of K elements including A_i, or the GCD of some specific selection (e.g., the first K elements including A_i)?
If multiple selections yield different GCDs, which one should be output? (e.g., maximum, minimum, or any?)
Are we required to choose exactly K distinct elements from the sequence, or can we choose any K indices (possibly with duplicates)?
Does 'choose K elements from A' mean we choose K positions (indices) from 1 to N, or K values from the multiset of A?
For each i, is the selection independent for each i, or is there a single global selection across all i?
If K=1, the only choice is A_i itself, so output is A_i. Is this interpretation correct?
